policy_name: Projeto de Lei nº 2.338, de 2023 — Dispõe sobre o desenvolvimento, o fomento e o uso ético e responsável da inteligência artificial com base na centralidade da pessoa humana (Brazil AI Bill / Marco Legal da IA)
issuing_authority: Congresso Nacional do Brasil — approved by the Senado Federal (author: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco); under review in the Câmara dos Deputados
regulatory_regime: Proposed risk-based AI framework with a National AI Regulation and Governance System (SIA) coordinated by the ANPD
geo_constraints: Brazil; AI systems developed, supplied or used in Brazil (scope to be confirmed in final text)

key_dates.event: PL 2338/2023 introduced in the Federal Senate by Senator Rodrigo Pacheco
Senate plenary approves substitute text (rapporteur Sen. Eduardo Gomes, CTIA) and sends it to the Chamber of Deputies
Received by the Câmara dos Deputados (Ofício nº 235/2025) for review under Art. 65 of the Constitution
Câmara President creates a Special Committee to give an opinion on PL 2338/2023 (constituted 29 April 2025)
Dep. Aguinaldo Ribeiro (PP-PB) designated rapporteur in the Special Committee
Rapporteur reportedly defers committee vote until after the October 2026 elections (secondary source)
Status per Câmara open-data API: 'Aguardando Parecer' — no rapporteur's opinion or vote yet; if amended by the Câmara it returns to the Senate

version: Text approved by the Federal Senate on 10 December 2024 (sent to the Câmara as Ofício nº 235/2025)
covered_entities: agentes de inteligência artificial: desenvolvedores (developers), distribuidores (distributors) and aplicadores (deployers)
exceptions: AI used by natural persons for purely private, non-economic purposes
AI developed and used exclusively for national defence
research, testing and development activities not placed on the market (subject to conditions)
conditions: High-risk obligations apply to systems in the statutory high-risk list (subject to regulator updates)
objective: Establish national norms for the responsible development, promotion and use of AI in Brazil, centred on the human person, to protect fundamental rights, ensure safe and reliable systems, and foster innovation, via a risk-based approach with prohibitions on excessive-risk uses and obligations for high-risk systems.
principles: respect for human rights and democratic values

related_policies.policy: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD, Lei nº 13.709/2018)
Código de Defesa do Consumidor (Lei nº 8.078/1990)

conflict_rule: Not yet law. The Senate text designates the ANPD as coordinator of the SIA, with sectoral regulators retaining competence in their domains; it is intended to operate alongside the LGPD and consumer protection law.

sources_consulted: Câmara open-data API /api/v2/proposicoes/2487262, via the GitHub mirror https://github.com/misspaiva/radar-pl-2338 (STATUS.md and data/historico-tramitacao.json, auto-generated 2026-11-09)
record_provenance.notes: camara.leg.br and senado.leg.br could not be fetched from this session, so the official bill text was NOT accessed. All clauses are Portuguese paraphrases (text_is_verbatim=false) with unofficial English translations; article numbers (Art. 12 preliminary assessment, Art. 13 excessive risk, Art. 14 high risk, Art. 25 algorithmic impact assessment) follow the Câmara avulso of the Senate-approved text as surfaced in search excerpts, but secondary sources number some provisions differently — verify before citing. No official English translation exists. Procedural dates from 2025-03-17 onward are taken from the Câmara open-data history (via a GitHub mirror that republishes the API). Introduction date (3 May 2023) and Senate rapporteur from general knowledge. Sanction ceiling (R$ 50 million per infraction or 2% of gross revenue) reported by Agência Senado-derived summaries; the revenue base (group/conglomerate in Brazil) and article number not verified. Exceptions list is from general knowledge of the Senate text and needs verification.

clauses.original_text: [Paráfrase — não é o texto oficial] São vedados o desenvolvimento, a implementação e o uso de sistemas de IA de risco excessivo, entre eles: sistemas que empreguem técnicas subliminares ou explorem vulnerabilidades para induzir comportamento danoso; sistemas de pontuação social pelo poder público que restrinjam ilegítima ou desproporcionalmente o acesso a bens, serviços e políticas públicas; sistemas que avaliem traços de personalidade ou comportamento passado para prever o risco de cometimento de crimes; sistemas de armas autônomas; e sistemas que possibilitem a produção ou disseminação de material de abuso ou exploração sexual de crianças e adolescentes; com regras específicas e exceções para identificação biométrica à distância, em tempo real, em espaços acessíveis ao público.
clauses.translated_text: [Unofficial translation of paraphrase] The development, deployment and use of excessive-risk AI systems are prohibited, including: systems using subliminal techniques or exploiting vulnerabilities to induce harmful behaviour; social scoring by public authorities that illegitimately or disproportionately restricts access to goods, services and public policies; systems assessing personality traits or past behaviour to predict the risk of committing crimes; autonomous weapons systems; and systems enabling the production or dissemination of child sexual abuse or exploitation material; with specific rules and exceptions for real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces.
clauses.actor: AI agents (developers, distributors, deployers), including public authorities
clauses.requirement: do not develop, deploy or use the listed excessive-risk AI applications
clauses.condition: system falls within an excessive-risk category
clauses.exception: real-time remote biometric identification permitted in limited cases (e.g. specific public-security / criminal investigation scenarios) under conditions set in the text
clauses.purpose: protect fundamental rights, safety and children
clauses.affected_asset: human dignity, autonomy, equality, life and physical integrity, children
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase reconstructed from search excerpts of the Câmara avulso and secondary summaries; enumeration order and exact scope of each item not verified. Not law.

clauses.original_text: [Paráfrase — não é o texto oficial] Antes de sua introdução e circulação no mercado, emprego ou utilização, o agente de IA poderá realizar avaliação preliminar para determinar o grau de risco do sistema, com base nos critérios previstos na lei e nas boas práticas; a avaliação preliminar é obrigatória para sistemas de IA generativa e de propósito geral.
clauses.translated_text: [Unofficial translation of paraphrase] Before placing on the market, deployment or use, the AI agent may carry out a preliminary assessment to determine the system's risk level, based on the criteria in the law and good practice; the preliminary assessment is mandatory for generative and general-purpose AI systems.
clauses.requirement: optional self-classification for most systems; mandatory for generative/general-purpose AI
clauses.condition: before placing on the market or use
clauses.purpose: classify systems to determine applicable obligations
clauses.applicable_systems: all AI systems; mandatory for generative and general-purpose AI
clauses.interpretation_notes: Câmara avulso excerpt shows 'poderá realizar avaliação preliminar'; the mandatory requirement for generative/general-purpose AI is reported by secondary sources and may sit in a different article. Modality MAY for the general rule (MUST for GPAI/GenAI).

clauses.original_text: [Paráfrase — não é o texto oficial] Consideram-se de alto risco os sistemas de IA empregados em finalidades e contextos como: dispositivos de segurança na gestão de infraestruturas críticas; educação e formação profissional (acesso, admissão e avaliação); recrutamento, seleção, promoção e decisões sobre relações de trabalho; avaliação de critérios de acesso a serviços públicos e privados essenciais; priorização de serviços de emergência; administração da justiça; veículos autônomos; aplicações na área da saúde; e investigação criminal e segurança pública, entre outros, podendo a autoridade competente atualizar a lista.
clauses.translated_text: [Unofficial translation of paraphrase] AI systems used for purposes and in contexts such as the following are considered high-risk: safety components in critical infrastructure management; education and vocational training (access, admission and evaluation); recruitment, selection, promotion and employment-relationship decisions; evaluating eligibility for essential public and private services; prioritization of emergency services; administration of justice; autonomous vehicles; health applications; and criminal investigation and public security, among others, with the competent authority able to update the list.
clauses.actor: legislator / competent authority (classification); AI agents (subject to obligations)
clauses.object: AI systems in listed use contexts
clauses.requirement: systems in listed contexts are subject to high-risk governance obligations
clauses.purpose: focus obligations on uses that can significantly affect rights and safety
clauses.affected_asset: fundamental rights, health, safety, access to essential services, employment
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase of the high-risk list; items and wording not verified against the official text, and the Senate removed some items (e.g. certain content-curation/recommendation systems) during negotiation — check final list.

clauses.original_text: [Paráfrase — não é o texto oficial] A avaliação de impacto algorítmico de sistemas de IA é obrigação do desenvolvedor e/ou do aplicador sempre que o sistema for considerado de alto risco, devendo ser realizada antes da colocação no mercado ou uso e atualizada periodicamente ao longo do ciclo de vida; as conclusões da avaliação de impacto algorítmico serão públicas, observados os segredos comercial e industrial.
clauses.translated_text: [Unofficial translation of paraphrase] An algorithmic impact assessment of AI systems is an obligation of the developer and/or deployer whenever the system is considered high-risk, to be carried out before placing on the market or use and updated periodically throughout the lifecycle; the conclusions of the algorithmic impact assessment shall be public, subject to commercial and industrial secrets.
clauses.actor: developer and/or deployer of high-risk AI
clauses.action: conduct and publish algorithmic impact assessment
clauses.requirement: perform, update and publish conclusions of an algorithmic impact assessment for high-risk AI
clauses.exception: commercial and industrial secrets protected in publication
clauses.purpose: identify and mitigate impacts on fundamental rights
clauses.interpretation_notes: Search excerpts of the avulso show the section heading 'Da Avaliação de Impacto Algorítmico' at Art. 25 and the sentence fragment 'As conclusões da avaliação de impacto algorítmico serão públicas'; allocation between developer and deployer and timing details are paraphrased and unverified.

clauses.section: Chapter on administrative sanctions (article number not verified)
clauses.original_text: [Paráfrase — não é o texto oficial] Os agentes de IA que cometerem infrações às normas da lei ficam sujeitos a sanções administrativas aplicadas pela autoridade competente, incluindo advertência, multa simples limitada a R$ 50.000.000,00 por infração ou, no caso de pessoa jurídica de direito privado, a até 2% do seu faturamento bruto, publicização da infração, proibição ou restrição de participar de sandbox regulatório e suspensão parcial ou total do desenvolvimento, fornecimento ou operação do sistema de IA.
clauses.translated_text: [Unofficial translation of paraphrase] AI agents that infringe the law are subject to administrative sanctions applied by the competent authority, including warning, a simple fine limited to R$ 50,000,000 per infringement or, for private legal entities, up to 2% of gross revenue, publication of the infringement, prohibition or restriction from participating in a regulatory sandbox, and partial or total suspension of the development, supply or operation of the AI system.
clauses.actor: competent authority (SIA / ANPD and sectoral regulators)
clauses.requirement: sanctions available for breaches, up to R$ 50 million or 2% of gross revenue
clauses.applicable_systems: all AI systems covered by the law
clauses.interpretation_notes: Paraphrase; the fine ceiling is consistently reported, but the revenue base (group/conglomerate in Brazil, prior fiscal year) and the full list of sanctions were not verified against official text.
